column1: # The family runs (store/family_runs/known-2026-10-29.tsv) the Rust host refuses on two vCPUs, held there by name to the refusal (Sprint 351): family, run, the stop w2m-vm --vcpus 2 writes. One refusal: a run that starts a child process, refused until the Machine has its own thread, the run-loop design's card 4f (crates/w2m_vm/src/host_request.rs MACHINE_ON_ONE; Sprint 325). Until Sprint 360 a second: a run whose family starts on the instruction clock, refused before any VM (crates/w2m_vm/src/run.rs vcpus_allowed; Sprint 315); from Sprint 360 that clock stays on one vCPU and a family's start on it runs on the wall clock above one (w2m-vm), and the two processes runs it held start a child process, so they are held to MACHINE_ON_ONE. Each conforms on one vCPU. Held by crates/w2m_vm/tests/family_runs.rs, which fails a run listed here that stops otherwise, a run not listed that stops so, and a stop here that is no refusal
